title: a_martian_odyssey__weinbaum
author: Weinbaum, Stanley G. (Stanley Grauman)
summary: Chemist Dick Jarvis recounts to his crewmates aboard the Ares his trek across the Martian desert after his rocket crashes, befriending the alien Tweel and encountering bizarre creatures including a silicon-based pyramid-builder, a hypnotic dream-beast, and hostile barrel-shaped mound dwellers.
